overall: AG found no violation: the Board did not deliberate on the license renewals it noticed for signing outside a meeting, and liaison reports and Town Administrator updates did not need item-level notice.

allegations.summary: Complaints said the Sept 25, 2025 notice topic to approve and sign outside a meeting all 2026 common victualler renewals lacked the specific businesses named.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board did not actually discuss any licenses, nor did it approve or deny any licenses.

allegations.summary: Complaints said the Reports from Board liaisons topic on the Sept 25 and Oct 7, 2025 notices was too broad and needed item-level detail.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that these types of specific announcements do not need to be listed on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Sept 25 liaison reports included a solid waste program briefing and Board discussion of expenditures, which the complaints said went beyond the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Although these discussions amounted to more than simple announcements, we do not find a violation where the notice of the September 25, 2025, meeting also included the following topic

allegations.summary: Complaints said the Oct 7, 2025 notice topic Town Administrator Updates and Reports was not specific enough.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the reports simply provided status updates to the Board and were generally not pieces of business that Board members anticipated discussing such that they needed to be listed on the notice.

allegations.summary: Not alleged in the complaints: AG noted Sept 25 minutes recorded a school budget update that the video did not show, and reminded the Board about minute accuracy.
